scope: Six ordinary nonfoil Eighth-frame sets. Shared font/placement; 8ED and 9ED artist placement selected from their own development names. Validation names shared across printings remain excluded from fitting. Matrix normal vs small-caps and range widening were development pilots; final production checks include background-free glyph metrics. Magnivore exposed a legacy font encoding issue and is a regression fixture rather than independent evidence for the star painter.
